provenance.earth_pole: pole of date (Celestial Intermediate Pole): IAU 2006 precession (Fukushima-Williams angles, IERS Conventions 2010) with IAU 2000B nutation (77 luni-solar terms), as SOFA/ERFA pn06 + nut00b, about 1 mas; polar motion and free-core nutation neglected; SPICE J2000 taken as the ICRF/GCRS axes; deviation from IAU_EARTH (pck00011) measured per epoch

earth_shape.atmosphere: not modelled (geometric line of sight to the solid Earth)
earth_shape.disk: exact projected limb ellipse; circular cap only within proven bounds (delta_max, E_g, E_f)
earth_shape.model: oblate spheroid, IERS Conventions 2010 (TN 36): a = 6378136.6 m, 1/f = 298.25642
